prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one hand-drawn animation in-between keyframe, an edit of Image 1.

Image 1 is the authoritative full-body starting pose A. Preserve its exact 1024 × 1536 canvas, framing, character scale, stationary body and transparent background. Image 2 is ONLY the ending pose B head-and-neck reference, shown at the original same-canvas position on a plain gray display background. Do not copy that gray background, and do not infer or invent any body from Image 2.

Create exactly ONE genuine halfway head-raising pose between A and B. In A the girl looks down toward the phone outside the image; in B she has raised her head toward her grandmother on image-right. Draw her head about halfway through that small upward turn. The chin, face plane, ears, eyes, bangs, crown curl and both pigtails move coherently with the head; the necessary neck anatomy connects naturally inside A's existing collar. Her chin and head angle must read between the two provided endpoints, not as a copy of either endpoint and not as moved pupils alone. Keep her eyes naturally open and mouth quietly closed. Keep the same girl, face proportions, hair, linework, colors and flat neutral lighting. This is a newly drawn in-between silhouette, not an image blend, doubled contour or distorted face.

Change ONLY the head, its hair and the minimum exposed neck required by that half-raised angle. Keep Image 1's white collar, shoulders, torso, both arms, every hand/finger, dress dots/folds, kneeling legs, knees, red sandal and all support contacts exactly unchanged. The anatomical left hand on image-right still grips exactly the same SINGLE short bamboo rod at the same position and angle. The anatomical right hand on image-left still rests on the ground in exactly the same supporting pose. Preserve the original body's alpha and edges; only the edited head/hair outline may have a different alpha silhouette. Do not move, scale, rotate or recrop the whole character.

Return one complete full-canvas 1024 × 1536 RGBA character cutout on a genuinely transparent background. No phone in her hands, no extra rod, no turtle, no grandmother, no lamp, no scenery, no shadows added to the background, no coordinate marks, no labels, no watermark. Preserve all existing objects and everything outside the limited head/neck edit.
